name: Tencent/LoopForge
title: Tencent/LoopForge
headline: Tencent LoopForge orchestrates coding agents with approval gates
lede: You can self-host workflows that drive CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates.

effects.effect: Multi-agent delivery pipelines with human checkpoints
Coding agents become interchangeable workflow steps

possibilities.title: Engineering teams can require a design review sign-off before any coding agent writes code

with.title: Plannotator still trending on daily and weekly charts

possibilities.connection: LoopForge sequences Codex, Claude Code and CodeBuddy with human approval gates, Google's elephant-goldfish-model supports agent-assisted design review, and Plannotator adds human review loops, so the gate can sit at the design stage instead of only at the diff.

possibilities.title: QA teams can let cloud agents fix staging bugs only behind human approval gates

with.title: Context-mode trims coding agent tool output via MCP

possibilities.connection: On 2026-11-14 Magpie suggested QA teams let Codex debug internal staging sites through a secure tunnel to Chrome DevTools MCP; today LoopForge adds self-hosted workflows that drive Codex with human approval gates, and Context-mode can trim the verbose browser output, which addresses the security objection that blocked the idea.
